run_renderer_speed_benchmark: run the renderer_speed_benchmark function to benchmark lightplane rendering speed across image sizes
run_test_one_full: run _test_one_full to benchmark a single renderer configuration with forward and backward passes
print_cuda_memory_usage: call print_memory_usage to display current CUDA memory statistics for the active device
review_test_one_full: review the _test_one_full function to understand how checkpoint, naive, and kernel modes are benchmarked
refactor_renderer_speed_benchmark: refactor renderer_speed_benchmark to add custom image sizes or modify the test sweep parameters
